about: DropIntel war history: one reading of the Helldivers 2 war every 15 minutes. Times are Unix seconds.

definition.title: MAJOR ORDER
definition.briefing: Kill the designated enemies to provide footage for the upcoming inspirational education film "Democratic Sniper."

definition.title: MAJOR ORDER
definition.briefing: Eliminate the mandated number of Terminids in order to restore public confidence, quell unlawful rumours of TCS+ failures, and safeguard Federal prosperity.

definition.title: MAJOR ORDER
definition.briefing: Acquire Automaton samples and kill Cyborgs to aid the development of enhanced digital interrogation techniques.

definition.title: STRATEGIC THREAT
definition.briefing: Investigate and, if warranted, hold the designated planets, in order to verify highly unlikely reports of TCS+ breaches.

setting.overrideBrief: Liberate the designated planet to secure essential footage for Democratic Sniper.
